name: serve requests in the current sweep direction
mechanism: move the head in one direction serving every pending request on the way, reverse at the end (or at the last request), so seek distance is bounded and no request starves

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Elevator algorithm' in section Operating systems algorithms / I/O scheduling / Disk scheduling: Disk scheduling algorithm that works like an elevator.

fails_when: middle positions get served twice as often as the ends
